rationale: Unit of analysis is the claim (12,845 rows, claim_id unique per manifest). Volume and status mix via claim_volume by claim_status with the status figure. Denial rate uses denominator=adjudicated_claims so pending claims (not yet accepted or denied) are excluded, matching the task definition; numerator/denominator and definitions are recorded by the component. Fraud-label prevalence is added explicitly (not default-selected) over all_claims because the task asks for prevalence across the whole portfolio. Financial summary covers billed, allowed and paid with sum_mean_quantiles so skewed amounts show median/p90/p99, not only means. Monthly trend is keyed on service_date_from (month the service began, spanning 2021-01 to 2023-12 per manifest) rather than the default adjudication_date, with claim_count as the volume series; the component reports unparseable_dates as required. Report prints every rate as numerator / denominator = rate, cites an artifact or metrics key for each results bullet, and carries the synthetic_data and descriptive_only caveats the task requires. No joins or group comparisons are needed, so the join and categorical-comparison skills were not applied.
